cohort: The study included 307 formula-fed infants aged 1-4 months.
finding: C-section delivery and higher socioeconomic status were associated with significantly lower Bifidobacterium abundance and altered intestinal physiology markers (higher fecal pH and lower fecal acetate) in formula-fed infants.
mod_finding: Infants born by C-section showed 57% lower Bifidobacterium abundance compared to those born vaginally, with socioeconomic status having a modifying effect.
